key_insight: Adding width to a quantum annealing network can dramatically reduce the depth needed for quantum search, with benefits reported already at width W = 2.
engineering_relevance: Learnable network width offers an architectural lever for improving quantum optimization success without relying solely on longer annealing evolution.
method: Extend quantum annealing to a quantum neural network.
Study random and parameter-tuned networks on prototypical optimization problems.
Vary network width and depth to assess quantum search performance.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports that random width-2 networks can exponentially reduce quantum search depth, while a tuned width-2, depth-1 quantum perceptron achieves exponentially small errors.
watch_item: The abstract does not establish hardware feasibility or quantify the cost of learning the network parameters, so reduced depth alone does not demonstrate practical speedup.
paper_title: Quantum Annealing with a Quantum Neural Network: Width of Annealing Matters
